question: what is this company worth, and what does the price already assume?

value_range.reading: No value range was computed. The calculator prints under valuation.missing: "WACC is not computed: the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched", and under cost_of_capital.missing: "the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". Part of the cost of capital is on record — the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, the equity risk premium of {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium|pct}, a pre-tax cost of debt of {cost_of_capital.pre_tax_cost_of_debt|pct} filled by a fallback of interest paid in cash over average debt, and the statutory tax rate of {cost_of_capital.tax_rate|pct} — but beta, the market value of equity, the weights and the cost of equity are empty, so no discount rate exists and no scenario's enterprise value, equity value or value per share was produced for bear, base or bull. A second gap would have stood in the way even with a discount rate: free cash flow to the firm is missing because the record holds no operating income row for the current year-to-date period, and the calculator will not substitute pretax income plus interest for it. What can be read is the drivers against the record. The base case starts revenue growth at the organic pace the release reports for the quarter, well below the trailing four-quarter growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} that carries acquired Maritime revenue and slightly below the three-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}; it holds the first-year operating margin level with the three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct} and the latest filled fiscal year's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}, and lets it rise modestly over ten years to a level above the best filled year, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_margin|pct}; its reinvestment rate sits above the near-zero rate the trailing period implies, where simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} was lifted by customer advances and by depreciation and amortization of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization} running far above capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure}. The bear case starts growth between the company's own flat years and the organic pace and holds the margin near its lowest filled year, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_margin|pct}, drifting lower; the bull case takes the year-ten margin several points above anything in the record. All three scenarios exclude the pending Megger acquisition, whose consideration, debt and share issuance arrive together at closing and none of which is in the calculator. Nothing here is a value: it is a set of stated assumptions waiting on a discount rate and a base-year operating income, and no value is estimated in their absence.

price_position.reading: No price position can be read: the calculator holds no price at the cutoff. The market table prints "no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched", the price-at-cutoff entry under the free-cash-flow-yield cross-check carries the same reason, and with no value range there is nothing for a price to sit inside. The filed claims a price would be set against are on record — total debt of {ratios.solvency.total_debt}, cash of {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now}, net debt of {ratios.solvency.net_debt}, operating lease liabilities of {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability}, and shares outstanding of {terms.shares_outstanding} against diluted shares of {terms.diluted_shares} — so the bridge from enterprise value to equity value per share is ready, but no enterprise value exists to start it from. The free-cash-flow-yield cross-check is likewise empty on both legs: it needs the market value of equity, which needs the price, and free cash flow to the firm, which needs the missing operating income.

market_implied_growth.reading: The reverse DCF was not run: the implied ten-year revenue growth entry prints "no reverse DCF: WACC is not computed: the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched", so what the price already assumes cannot be read, and no estimate is offered in its place. What the record does offer is the growth the company has filed and the growth management guides to. The three-year compound rate is {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} and the five-year rate {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}, both carrying acquisitions; the trailing four-quarter growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} and the quarter's year-over-year growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} carry acquired Maritime revenue that laps from the fourth quarter; and the record holds two fiscal years of flat or negative revenue, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.revenue_growth|pct} and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.revenue_growth|pct}, beside two acquisition years well above the averages, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.revenue_growth|pct} and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.revenue_growth|pct}. The guidance quoted below is a full-year figure that includes the Maritime contribution; the release separates the quarter's growth into an organic part and the Maritime part, and the organic part is the pace the base case starts from, fading in a straight line to a terminal rate below the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}. The bear case starts between the company's own flat years and that organic pace; the bull case starts above the three-year compound rate but below the quarter's acquired growth. Whether the price sits inside, below or above that band of assumptions is exactly the question the missing reverse DCF would have answered, and it is left open here.
market_implied_growth.quote: Raising the lower end of FY 2026 Sales guidance and now expect Sales to be in the range of $1.30 to $1.33 billion (19 to 21 percent growth over the prior year).

most_sensitive.assumption: the discount rate (cost of capital), which is the input that is missing
most_sensitive.reading: The sensitivity grid was not computed, so no assumption's effect on value is measured here; what follows is read from the structure of the stated formula and from the spread of the drivers, not from a grid. The first assumption value rests on is the one the calculator could not fill: the discount rate. Every scenario's ten years of cash flow and its terminal value are divided by it. The calculator holds the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, the equity risk premium of {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium|pct}, a pre-tax cost of debt of {cost_of_capital.pre_tax_cost_of_debt|pct} taken from interest paid over average debt as a fallback, and the statutory tax rate of {cost_of_capital.tax_rate|pct}, while beta, the market value of equity, the debt and equity weights and the cost of equity are empty. With total debt of {ratios.solvency.total_debt} against stockholders' equity of {terms.balances_now.stockholders_equity} even at book, the equity weight would dominate the blend and the cost of equity, which needs the beta, would set most of the rate. Until a price series is supplied no value can be read, and once it is, the rate will remain the assumption most able to move it; the Megger financing, which would add debt the record does not yet hold, would change the weights again at closing.

most_sensitive.assumption: the terminal state: year-ten operating margin together with terminal growth
most_sensitive.reading: The second is the terminal state, the year-ten operating margin together with the terminal growth rate, because in a ten-year fade with terminal growth held at or below the risk-free rate the terminal value is typically the largest part of enterprise value, and the scenario spread in the drivers is widest here. The bear year-ten margin sits below the lowest filled fiscal year, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_margin|pct}; the base sits above the best filled year, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_margin|pct}; the bull sits several points above anything in the record; and the three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct} is the anchor all three move from, so the bear-to-bull spread is wider than the whole range of filled fiscal years. The margin path hangs on whether acquired-intangible amortization, a non-cash charge inside operating income whose room is the gap between trailing depreciation and amortization of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization} and capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure}, runs off or is replenished by Megger, and on whether the volume leverage and price increases management describes outlast the inflationary pressure and unfavorable mix it also names. Terminal growth sits below the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct} in every scenario, the bear nearer inflation and the bull just under the ceiling. No grid measured either effect; this is the reading a grid would have tested.

accounting_adjustments.reading: There were none. The accounting analysis lists no adjustments, and the calculator's quality-adjusted free cash flow applied none and refused none: quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} differs from simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} only by the standing deductions of share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} and acquisition payments of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}, the Maritime working-capital settlement and group tax-relief payment. The items the accounting reader flagged — a bad-debt allowance that thinned while receivables rose, unbilled contract assets rising for a second quarter on a timing explanation, other current assets nearly doubling without a breakdown, adjusted-earnings exclusions widening on items that recur — were each judged too small to adjust or not sized by any calculator field, so none moved value; with no valuation computed there was in any case no value for them to move. What the drivers do carry from that analysis is a reinvestment rate set above the near-zero rate the trailing period implies, because contract liabilities rose from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} to {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} and the accounting reader treats that cash as borrowed from future quarters; that is a driver choice, not an accounting adjustment, and it is recorded as such in the assumptions.

summary_ko.value_range: 이번에는 가치 범위가 계산되지 않았다. 계산기는 주가 시계열이 없어 베타와 자기자본비용, 곧 가중평균자본비용을 구할 수 없었다고 적고 있으며, 무위험이자율 {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}와 주식위험프리미엄 {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium|pct}, 세전 타인자본비용 {cost_of_capital.pre_tax_cost_of_debt|pct}만 채워져 있다. 이번 누적 기간의 영업이익 행도 없어 기업잉여현금흐름이 비어 있으므로, 약세·기본·강세 어느 시나리오도 주당가치로 이어지지 못했고 추정치로 대신하지 않는다.
summary_ko.price_position: 기준일 주가가 계산기에 없어 주가가 가치 범위 안 어디에 있는지 읽을 수 없다. 총차입금 {ratios.solvency.total_debt}, 현금 {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now}, 순차입금 {ratios.solvency.net_debt}, 발행주식수 {terms.shares_outstanding} 등 주가와 견줄 때 필요한 재무 수치는 기록에 있지만, 견줄 대상인 기업가치 자체가 산출되지 않았다.
summary_ko.market_implied_growth: 역산 DCF가 실행되지 않아 현재 주가가 어떤 성장률을 전제하는지는 알 수 없고, 추정치로 대신하지도 않는다. 회사의 삼년 연복리 매출성장률은 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}, 오년은 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}이며, 최근 네 분기 성장률 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}에는 인수한 Maritime 매출이 들어 있고, 기본 시나리오는 보도자료가 밝힌 유기적 성장 속도에서 출발해 무위험이자율 {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct} 아래의 영구성장률로 수렴한다.
summary_ko.most_sensitive: 민감도 표가 계산되지 않았으므로 측정된 결과는 없다. 공식의 구조상 가치는 첫째로 비어 있는 할인율, 곧 베타가 필요한 자기자본비용에 가장 크게 좌우되고, 둘째로 십년째 영업이익률과 영구성장률이 정하는 잔존가치에 좌우되며, 약세와 강세 시나리오의 십년째 영업이익률 차이는 기록된 회계연도의 최저 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_margin|pct}와 최고 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_margin|pct} 사이의 폭보다 넓다.
summary_ko.accounting_adjustments: 회계 조정은 하나도 없었다. 품질조정 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}는 단순 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}에서 주식보상비용 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}과 인수 관련 지급액 {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}만 뺀 것이며, 회계 분석이 지적한 항목들은 조정으로 이어지지 않았고 가치평가 자체가 계산되지 않아 움직일 가치도 없었다.

limits: This valuation is a set of stated assumptions run through a stated formula. It states no recommendation to trade, and a different reader choosing different drivers would reach a different value.
